milestones.title: M0: Foundation
milestones.description: Monorepo, launcher, authentication, sessions, CSRF, migrations, audit table, actor model, pending API surface and development seed.

milestones.title: M1: Organization, budgets and domain core
milestones.description: Departments with budgets, organization settings, integer money and the bid comparison engine that later milestones build on.

milestones.title: M2: Purchase requests and approvals
milestones.description: Purchase request lifecycle, immutable revisions, threshold-based approval routing, no-self-approval and attachments.

milestones.title: M3: Suppliers and RFQ events
milestones.description: Supplier directory, supplier logins, RFQ creation from approved requests, criteria, publish/freeze, invitations and server-side deadlines.

milestones.title: M4: Supplier portal and bidding
milestones.description: Isolated supplier portal, sealed bid drafts and revisions, deadline-safe submission and withdrawal.

milestones.title: M5: Evaluation and award
milestones.description: Comparison matrix on persisted bids, evaluator scoring, disqualification, award recommendation and finance approval with snapshots.

milestones.title: M6: Purchase orders and receiving
milestones.description: PO issue with budget commitment control, print-ready PO, partial receipts, over-receipt rejection and idempotent financial POSTs.

milestones.title: M7: Reporting, notifications and governance
milestones.description: Dashboard, spend and supplier reports, CSV export, in-app notifications, audit log viewer and account settings.

milestones.title: M8: Acceptance and hardening
milestones.description: Full PRD §8 demo dataset, Playwright acceptance suite B-01..B-18, security and accessibility verification, deployment pipeline.

tickets.title: Set up monorepo, run.sh launcher and CI pipeline
tickets.description: npm-workspaces monorepo with API, web and shared packages, a single run.sh entry point and a GitHub Actions pipeline. A fresh clone must reach a running app with one command.
acceptanceCriteria: ./run.sh takes a fresh clone to a running API and web UI
./run.sh check runs lint, format, typecheck and tests
CI runs secret scan, lint, typecheck, tests with coverage and build on every push

tickets.title: Implement session authentication with scrypt, CSRF and rate limiting
tickets.description: Server-side sessions with hashed tokens, scrypt password hashing, HMAC CSRF tokens bound to the session and rate limiting on login. Generic login errors avoid account enumeration.
acceptanceCriteria: Login sets an HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie and returns a CSRF token
Unsafe requests without a valid CSRF token are rejected with 403
Wrong password, unknown email and inactive user return the same 401

tickets.title: Add migration runner, append-only audit table and health checks
tickets.description: Forward-only SQL migrations with checksums, an audit_events table written in the same transaction as state changes, and liveness/readiness endpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: Migrations apply in order and refuse edited files
Running migrations twice applies nothing
/api/health/ready returns 503 when PostgreSQL is unreachable

tickets.title: Define buyer actor model and RBAC permission matrix
tickets.description: Replace template roles with the six PRD §3 roles and a shared permission matrix used by API guards and web navigation. Migration 0002 adds a CHECK constraint on users.role.
acceptanceCriteria: ROLES matches PRD §3 exactly
requirePermission returns 401 unauthenticated and 403 for roles outside the matrix
Database rejects unknown role values

tickets.title: Seed development organizations, role logins and departments
tickets.description: Idempotent development-only seed with Cedar Grove Hotels and Harborview Clinics, one login per role in the primary organization, an admin in the secondary organization and departments in both.
acceptanceCriteria: Seed refuses to run when NODE_ENV=production
Re-running the seed creates no duplicates
Every demo login is documented in README

tickets.title: Register pending API surface and navigation with ticket ids
tickets.description: Register every PRD §7 endpoint as a pending route with its permission and ticket so the contract is explicit, and list every PRD §4 screen in navigation with role visibility.
acceptanceCriteria: Pending endpoints return 401/403 before 501 with their ticket id
Every PRD §4 screen appears in navigation or is reachable from a listed screen
An HTTP test asserts a sample of pending routes

tickets.title: Build money module: minor units, basis points, rounding and formatting
tickets.description: Integer minor-unit Money with currency, basis-point rates, fixed-point quantities, one documented rounding rule (half up, once), safe price × quantity with overflow guards and float-free parsing/formatting for the web.
acceptanceCriteria: No floating-point arithmetic on amounts
Unit price × fractional quantity rounds once, half up
Overflow beyond the safe integer range throws AMOUNT_OVERFLOW
100% branch coverage on domain files

tickets.title: Build bid comparison and weighted scoring engine
tickets.description: Pure, deterministic engine computing line and bid totals, lowest-priced vs lowest qualified bid, FR-06 price normalization, weighted qualitative scores, ranking with deterministic tie-breaking and recommendation eligibility.
acceptanceCriteria: Weights not totalling 100% are rejected with a clear message (B-09)
A disqualified or non-compliant cheapest bid is shown but excluded from normalization and ranking (B-10)
Recommending a non-top-ranked bid requires justification (B-11)
Ties resolve by price, lead time, submission time, then bid id

tickets.title: Implement departments with budgets API (list, create, get)
tickets.description: Tenant-scoped department repository, service and routes with zod validation, pagination and search, budgets stored as bigint minor units in the organization currency, and an audit event in the same transaction.
acceptanceCriteria: List, create and get are scoped to the session organization
Create is limited to Buyer Admin; suppliers and receiving clerks get 403
Duplicate codes return 409 and leave no audit row
Budget currency is taken from the organization, never the request

tickets.title: Build departments and budgets screen
tickets.description: Departments list with search, formatted budgets and empty/error states, plus an admin-only create form that converts major-unit input to integer minor units without floats.
acceptanceCriteria: Budgets display as e.g. USD 180,000.00
Create form rejects more decimals than the currency allows
Non-admin roles see the list without the form

tickets.title: Prove department tenant isolation and RBAC against PostgreSQL
tickets.description: Integration suite against a disposable PostgreSQL database proving that a second buyer organization cannot list or read the first organization's departments and that role enforcement holds.
acceptanceCriteria: Org B reading an Org A department id returns 404 with no data
Requester can read but not create; supplier and clerk get 403
Audit row is written exactly once per create

tickets.title: Implement organization settings: currency, timezone, approval threshold
tickets.description: Buyer Admin manages the organization default currency, display timezone and spend-approval threshold (minor units). The threshold feeds approval routing and award checks.
acceptanceCriteria: Only Buyer Admin can update settings
Threshold is stored as integer minor units
Currency cannot change once purchase requests exist

tickets.title: Add department update/deactivate and cost centers
tickets.description: PATCH departments with optimistic locking on version, deactivation that preserves history, and cost centers per department.
acceptanceCriteria: Stale version returns 409
Deactivated departments cannot receive new requests
Cost center codes are unique per organization

tickets.title: Add budget periods and requested/approved/committed rollups
tickets.description: Per-period budgets table and read model showing requested, approved and committed amounts with definitions. Budget is a planning control, not a ledger.
acceptanceCriteria: Rollups are computed from persisted requests and POs
Definitions are shown next to each figure
Missing data displays as Not available

tickets.title: Implement user and department membership administration
tickets.description: Buyer Admin creates and deactivates users, assigns roles and department memberships. Requests are only allowed for departments the requester belongs to.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin cannot remove the last Buyer Admin
Deactivated users lose active sessions
Membership is checked on every purchase request write

tickets.title: Create purchase request schema, codes and line items
tickets.description: Migration for purchase_requests and purchase_request_lines with numeric quantities, minor-unit estimates, version and per-organization unique request codes.
acceptanceCriteria: Codes are unique per organization and generated server-side
Quantities must be positive
Every table carries organization_id

tickets.title: Build purchase request create, list and detail API
tickets.description: Requesters create draft requests with validated lines; list supports status/department filters and pagination; detail returns lines and history.
acceptanceCriteria: Rows with zero or negative quantity are rejected
Requesters only see requests they may access
Filters and pagination follow API conventions

tickets.title: Implement submit, revise and cancel with immutable revisions
tickets.description: Submission freezes a revision snapshot; editing after submission creates a revised draft requiring resubmission while decision history remains; cancel requires a reason.
acceptanceCriteria: Submitted revision is immutable
Revise creates a new draft revision and keeps prior decisions
Invalid transitions return INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION

tickets.title: Build approval routing rules for manager and over-threshold finance steps
tickets.description: Pure rules generating ordered approval steps: department manager approval, plus finance approval when the estimate exceeds the organization threshold.
acceptanceCriteria: Requests above threshold get an ordered finance step
Threshold comparison uses integer minor units
Unit tests cover boundary values

tickets.title: Implement approvals inbox and decision API with no-self-approval
tickets.description: Approvers list pending steps and approve/reject/request clarification. The API denies decisions by the request author and writes ordered audit events.
acceptanceCriteria: Requester approving own request is denied by the API (B-02)
Finance approval above threshold changes status and audits in order (B-03)
Decisions are idempotent on retry

tickets.title: Build purchase request list, editor and detail timeline screens
tickets.description: List with filters, line-item editor with money and quantity inputs, and detail page with attachments and approval timeline.
acceptanceCriteria: Editor validates quantities and amounts before submit
Timeline shows each decision with actor and time
Irreversible actions ask for confirmation

tickets.title: Store attachments on local disk with type and size limits
tickets.description: Attachment upload for requests and bids with MIME/extension allow-list, size limit, random storage names and tenant-checked downloads.
acceptanceCriteria: Disallowed types and oversize files are rejected
Files are served only to authorized users of the owning record
Metadata is stored in SQL, bytes on disk

tickets.title: Build approvals inbox screen
tickets.description: Inbox of pending approval steps for requests and awards with approve, reject and request-clarification actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Only steps the user may decide are listed
Decision requires a reason when rejecting
Empty state explains there is nothing to approve

tickets.title: Implement supplier directory API with activate/deactivate
tickets.description: Supplier organization profiles (contact, categories, tax-registration text, country, status, notes) scoped to the buyer organization. Deactivation blocks new responses and preserves submissions.
acceptanceCriteria: Deactivated suppliers cannot submit new bids
Existing submissions remain visible for audit
Tax registration is stored as unverified text

tickets.title: Provision supplier logins and supplier memberships
tickets.description: Buyer admin or procurement provisions a supplier user login linked to a supplier organization and records the portal invitation in the database. No email is sent.
acceptanceCriteria: Supplier users are linked to exactly one supplier organization
Provisioning is audited
UI never claims an email was sent

tickets.title: Build supplier directory screen
tickets.description: Searchable supplier list with status badges, profile detail and activate/deactivate with confirmation.
acceptanceCriteria: Status changes require confirmation
Search filters by name and category
Inactive suppliers are clearly marked

tickets.title: Create RFQs from approved requests with line snapshots
tickets.description: Procurement creates an RFQ only from an approved purchase request; request lines are snapshotted into rfq_lines and can be clarified while in draft.
acceptanceCriteria: RFQ creation from a non-approved request is rejected
RFQ currency is fixed to the request currency
Draft lines can be clarified; request lines are unchanged

tickets.title: Configure evaluation criteria and block invalid weights on publish
tickets.description: Persist evaluation_criteria with weight_bps and validate with the shared engine; publishing or evaluation is blocked when weights do not total 100%.
acceptanceCriteria: Publishing with weights totalling 95% returns 422 with WEIGHTS_NOT_100_PERCENT (B-09)
Exactly one price criterion is required
Criteria are frozen after publication

tickets.title: Publish RFQs, freeze requirements and handle amendments
tickets.description: Publishing freezes commercial line definitions; any material amendment creates a new revision and notifies invitees in-app. No silent edits.
acceptanceCriteria: Edits to published lines are rejected
Amendment increments revision and notifies invitees
Publication is audited

tickets.title: Manage RFQ invitations and invitation states
tickets.description: Invite active suppliers to an RFQ with one invitation per supplier and track states (invited, viewed, responded, declined).
acceptanceCriteria: Duplicate invitations are prevented by UNIQUE(rfq_id, supplier_org_id)
Invited supplier portals show the RFQ after publication (B-04)
Inactive suppliers cannot be invited

tickets.title: Enforce RFQ deadlines server-side with manual close and demo clock
tickets.description: Deadline is stored in UTC and enforced with the server clock; buyers may close early with an audited reason; an admin-only demo action advances simulated deadlines for tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Submissions after the deadline are rejected regardless of client clock (B-08)
Early close requires a reason and is audited
Demo clock advance is unavailable in production

tickets.title: Build RFQ list, creation wizard and detail screens
tickets.description: RFQ list with stage tabs and search, a wizard for scope, lines, suppliers, criteria and deadline, and a detail page with invitation states.
acceptanceCriteria: Wizard shows live weight total and blocks invalid totals
Deadline is shown in the organization timezone
Publishing asks for confirmation

tickets.title: Enforce supplier portal isolation and record-level guards
tickets.description: Supplier namespace that resolves the caller's supplier organization from the session and only returns RFQs it is invited to. Competitor identities, scores and budgets never appear in supplier payloads.
acceptanceCriteria: Uninvited supplier opening an RFQ id gets 404 with no content (B-05)
Supplier A requesting supplier B's bid gets 404 (B-06)
Supplier payloads contain no internal scores or budgets

tickets.title: Implement supplier bid drafts and revisions
tickets.description: One current bid per supplier and RFQ; saving creates a new revision and preserves previous versions. Lines capture unit price (minor units), quantity confirmation, lead time and compliance.
acceptanceCriteria: Draft save persists a new revision
Previous revisions remain readable to the supplier
Prices are validated as integer minor units in the RFQ currency

tickets.title: Implement bid submit and withdraw with deadline checks
tickets.description: Submit records the submitted timestamp from the server clock; withdraw is allowed before close; submitted bids become read-only at close. Supplier can read its own award outcome.
acceptanceCriteria: Submitted timestamp and revision persist (B-07)
Late submit is rejected (B-08)
Withdrawn bids cannot win

tickets.title: Build supplier portal screens: invitations and response form
tickets.description: Responsive supplier portal listing invited RFQs and a response form with per-line price, lead time, compliance and attachments.
acceptanceCriteria: Usable at 360px width
Form shows the RFQ currency and deadline countdown
Submit asks for confirmation

tickets.title: Wire persisted bids into the comparison endpoint
tickets.description: GET /rfqs/:id/comparison loads submitted bids, qualifications and scores after close and returns the engine output. Sealed bids are never returned before close.
acceptanceCriteria: Endpoint returns 409 before the RFQ is closed
Matrix uses persisted bid data only
Cross-currency bids are rejected, not converted

tickets.title: Implement evaluator scoring and disqualification API
tickets.description: Evaluators record 0-100 scores with rationale per qualitative criterion; disqualification and its clearance require a reason and are audited.
acceptanceCriteria: Disqualified lowest bid is excluded from normalization and award (B-10)
Scores outside 0-100 return 422
Every score and qualification change is audited

tickets.title: Build bid comparison matrix screen
tickets.description: Matrix with RFQ lines as rows and qualified suppliers as columns, totals, lead times, normalized price points, weighted scores and flags for unqualified bids.
acceptanceCriteria: Lowest-priced and lowest qualified bids are both labelled
Unqualified bids are shown with reasons but unranked
Scores display rounded to two decimals

tickets.title: Record award recommendations with bid and score snapshots
tickets.description: Procurement recommends one bid for all lines with reasoning; the recommendation stores the selected bid revision, criteria and score snapshot. Non-top-ranked choices require justification.
acceptanceCriteria: Non-top-ranked recommendation without justification is rejected (B-11)
Snapshot is immutable after creation
Unqualified bids cannot be recommended

tickets.title: Approve awards and create the PO draft exactly once
tickets.description: Finance approval is required when above threshold, over budget or non-top-ranked; the author cannot approve; an approved award creates a PO draft in the same transaction with a unique award constraint.
acceptanceCriteria: Approved award creates exactly one PO draft with the bid snapshot (B-12)
Duplicate approval POSTs create no duplicate records (B-17)
Recommendation author cannot approve

tickets.title: Build award recommendation and approval screen
tickets.description: Award detail showing comparative scores, selected bid, deviation justification and the approval trail with decision actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Deviation from top-ranked bid is highlighted
Approve/reject require confirmation
Snapshot values match the approved bid

tickets.title: Issue purchase orders with budget commitment control
tickets.description: Issuing a PO checks authorization, approval state and remaining department budget inside a transaction with row locks; over-budget issue is blocked unless a finance exception is approved.
acceptanceCriteria: Unauthorized PO issue is denied and audited (B-13)
Issuing a PO that exceeds remaining budget without an approved exception is rejected
Issued price and line data are immutable

tickets.title: Build purchase order list/detail API and print-ready PO
tickets.description: PO list and detail endpoints plus a print-friendly PO page with organization-specific PO number, lines, totals, approval references and terms.
acceptanceCriteria: Print stylesheet renders a one-page PO
Totals are computed from integer minor units
Terminology says purchase order, never invoice

tickets.title: Record receipts with partial delivery and over-receipt rejection
tickets.description: Receiving clerk records per-line received quantities; cumulative receipts cannot exceed ordered quantity; PO state moves to partially or fully received.
acceptanceCriteria: Partial receipt updates outstanding quantity and PO state (B-14)
Over-receipt is rejected and persisted totals are unchanged (B-15)
Duplicate receipt POST creates one record (B-17)

tickets.title: Build receipts screen
tickets.description: Receipts page showing ordered, received and outstanding quantities per PO line with a receipt entry form.
acceptanceCriteria: Outstanding quantity updates after a receipt
Over-receipt error is shown inline
Usable on tablet widths

tickets.title: Add idempotency keys for financial POST endpoints
tickets.description: Idempotency-Key header support storing request hash and response for approval, award, PO issue and receipt endpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: Replaying a key returns the original response
Reusing a key with a different body returns 409
Keys expire after 24 hours

tickets.title: Build buyer dashboard API and screen
tickets.description: Dashboard cards for pending approvals, RFQs closing soon, active POs, outstanding receipts, late deliveries and committed purchase value.
acceptanceCriteria: Every figure is computed from persisted data
Missing data shows Not available
Cards link to filtered lists

tickets.title: Build spend and supplier performance reports with CSV export
tickets.description: Spend by department/category/supplier, average bids per RFQ, RFQ cycle time and delivery punctuality, with CSV export of authorized filtered data.
acceptanceCriteria: CSV contains only rows the user may see
Amounts export as plain decimals from minor units
Percentages are never invented when data is missing

tickets.title: Deliver in-app notifications and background worker
tickets.description: Notification inbox and a polling worker for RFQ closing and delivery overdue alerts; event-driven alerts for approval requested, RFQ published, bid submitted and award decided.
acceptanceCriteria: Notifications are scoped to the recipient
Worker is idempotent across restarts
No external email is sent

tickets.title: Build audit log API and viewer
tickets.description: Paginated, filterable read access to audit_events for admins and finance with actor, entity, event type, timestamp and snapshot hashes.
acceptanceCriteria: Only the caller organization's events are returned
Filters by entity and action
No endpoint can modify audit events

tickets.title: Build account settings screen
tickets.description: Profile display name and password change with current-password verification; password change revokes other sessions.
acceptanceCriteria: Password change requires the current password
Other sessions are revoked after change
Minimum password length is enforced

tickets.title: Seed the full PRD §8 demonstration dataset
tickets.description: Extend the development seed with suppliers, the 20-unit air-conditioning request, an RFQ with three bids including a cheapest unqualified bid, an award pending finance approval, an issued PO with 40% received and an expired RFQ.
acceptanceCriteria: Seed reproduces every PRD §8 scenario on a reset database
Seed stays idempotent
Data is clearly development-only

tickets.title: Automate acceptance tests B-01 to B-04 in Playwright
tickets.description: Playwright scenarios for request submission, self-approval denial, finance approval above threshold and RFQ publication against the real database.
acceptanceCriteria: Scenarios run on a reset local dataset
Each scenario asserts both UI and API outcomes
Suite runs in CI

tickets.title: Automate acceptance tests B-05 to B-09 in Playwright
tickets.description: Playwright and API scenarios for supplier isolation, bid draft and submit, late submission and invalid criteria weights.
acceptanceCriteria: Direct API calls by the wrong supplier return 403/404
Late submit uses the demo clock and is rejected
Invalid weights block publication

tickets.title: Automate acceptance tests B-10 to B-18 in Playwright
tickets.description: Scenarios for disqualification, justified non-top award, award to PO, unauthorized issue, partial and over-receipt, restart persistence, duplicate POSTs and cross-tenant access.
acceptanceCriteria: Restart test proves bids, scores, PO and receipts persist (B-16)
Duplicate POSTs create no duplicate financial records (B-17)
Org B sees no Org A data across all endpoints (B-18)

tickets.title: Run tenant-isolation sweep and ASVS L2 security verification
tickets.description: Automated sweep calling every implemented endpoint as a foreign tenant and a wrong role, plus an ASVS L2 checklist review and dependency audit.
acceptanceCriteria: Every endpoint is covered by the sweep
No high-severity findings remain open
Results recorded in the threat model

tickets.title: Accessibility and responsive supplier portal pass
tickets.description: Audit key screens against WCAG 2.1 AA with axe and keyboard testing; fix contrast, focus and labelling issues; verify supplier portal on small screens.
acceptanceCriteria: No serious axe violations on key screens
All actions reachable by keyboard
Supplier portal usable at 360px

tickets.title: Build production container image and deployment pipeline
tickets.description: Multi-stage container image, migrations as a release step, secrets from a manager, health-checked rolling deploy as described in docs/operations/deployment.md.
acceptanceCriteria: Image runs as non-root with no dev dependencies
Migrations run once per release before traffic shifts
No secrets baked into the image
